description: Indian money calculators with the rules written in: sip (monthly, rate, years, stepup), lumpsum (amount, rate, years), emi (amount, rate, years or months, schedule), gst (amount, rate, inclusive, interstate), income-tax (income, year, regime new/old/both, age, salaried, deductions), hra (basic, hra, rent, metro), gratuity (salary, years, covered), ppf (yearly, years, rate), capital-gains (asset, bought, sold, cost, price, expenses) and trade (buy, sell, quantity, kind, brokerage, dp). Rates are percent a year, amounts rupees. Each answer names the rule and year used.

inputs.description: The calculator's inputs by name, as listed for its kind, for example {"income": 1500000, "regime": "both"}.

name: calculate_indian_money
title: Calculate indian money
